The Front Office Transaction Log merges these by player_id ahead of the live worker events. Keith 2026-06-01: Rodgers is the inaugural deep-history worked example (dispersal era 2012-2018).
_meta.source_of_truth: memory/ups_rodgers_contract_history.md + memory/ups_dispersal_draft_2012_inaugural.md (validated 2026-05-09 vs MFL W=1 snapshots + Forumotion threads)
_meta.confidence_legend: ok = forum/MFL-validated; derived = inferred from contractInfo annotations or carryover (forum gap) — flagged ~ in the UI
_meta.note: franchise_name carries the historical owner/team (current-day franchise names differ)
